fullPassage: Have you ever noticed that the buttons on men's clothing and women's clothing are arranged differently? On men's shirts, the buttons are located on the wearer's right-hand side. On women's shirts, they are on the left-hand side. This is because of a tradition that began when clothing with buttons was expensive. Women who were wealthy enough to buy button-up clothing rarely dressed themselves. Instead, they were dressed by maids, who, like most people, were usually right-handed. Therefore, clothing makers made it easier for the maids to fasten the buttons by putting them on the wearer's left-hand side. Today, most people dress themselves and the placement of buttons can differ depending on the designer or brand, but many clothing makers are still reluctant to change such a well-known tradition.
